per_row.label: answer
turns: How many unused vacation days can I carry over to next year?
replies:
You can carry over up to **5 unused annual leave days** to the next calendar year. These carried-over days must be used by **31 March** of that year; otherwise, they will expire. Any days above the carry-over limit will expire on **31 December**.

Sources: [leave-policy §3.4]

per_row.label: answer
turns: Do I get paid sick leave?
replies:
As a contractor at Lumora Tech, you do not receive paid sick leave. The sick leave policy applies only to full-time and part-time employees, so you should inform your manager about any absence according to your service agreement instead of relying on paid sick leave benefits.

Sources: [sick-leave-policy §1.1]
